summary: Tested admin auth (JWT), CRUD endpoints, and admin dashboard UI. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend flows working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: logger is defined after it is used in startup() — this works due to Python's late binding but is a code smell; consider moving logging setup before startup handler
CORS allows '*' by default — fine for preview, should be restricted in production
seed_data_creation: 5 blog posts seeded on startup if DB is empty
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin flows verified: login, JWT token, /admin/me, blog CRUD (create/update/delete/auth guard), contacts endpoint, dashboard UI with tabs, post form, logout, and unauthenticated redirect. Backend 12/12 tests passing.
